name.en-US: Sermon to the People of the Church of Caesarea
name.pt-BR: Sermão ao povo da Igreja de Cesareia

description.la: Sermo ad Caesareensis ecclesiae plebem. Textus Latinus secundum editionem Maurinorum.
description.en-US: Sermon to the People of the Church of Caesarea (418), by St. Augustine of Hippo. Latin text of the Maurist edition; no public-domain English translation has been imported yet.
description.pt-BR: Sermão ao povo da Igreja de Cesareia (418), de Santo Agostinho de Hipona. Texto latino da edição dos Maurinos.

sources.edition: Maurist text (Benedictines of Saint-Maur, 1679-1700) as printed in Migne, Patrologia Latina, on augustinus.it (Corpus Augustinianum Gissense / NBA Latin pages)
sources.description: Latin pages discorso_cesarea of augustinus.it, one page per book, long pages split at chapter boundaries. The Italian NBA headings, summaries and biblical-reference notes are dropped; section numbers and italicised quotations are kept. Raw mirror in research/sourcing/augustine-latin/raw.
sources.tierEvidence: Text of a 4th-5th-century work in the Maurist edition (1679-1700, Migne 1841-49), long public domain.
